name: Signed macOS package

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      source_sha:
        description: Full merged release source commit SHA to package.
        required: ******
        type: string
      allow_merged_source:
        description: Permit an exact commit contained in the selected branch for release assembly.
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
    secrets:
      MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE:
        required: false
      MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD:
        required: false
      MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE:
        required: false
      MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD:
        required: false
      MACOS_NOTARY_KEY:
        required: false
      MACOS_NOTARY_KEY_ID:
        required: false
      MACOS_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID:
        required: false
      MACOS_TEAM_ID:
        required: false
permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: signed-macos-package
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  signed-package:
    name: Sign, notarize, staple, and accept macOS arm64 package
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 45
    environment: native-release-signing

    steps:
      - name: Require an exact protected merged source
        env:
          ALLOW_MERGED_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.allow_merged_source }}
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_sha }}
        run: |
          if [ "$REF_TYPE" != branch ]; then
            echo "::error::Signed packaging must be dispatched from a protected branch"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$ALLOW_MERGED_SOURCE" != ****** ]; then
            echo "::error::Signed packaging requires an explicitly selected merged source"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ ! "$SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::source_sha must be a full commit SHA"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check out trusted source
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Confirm the protected branch contains the exact source
        env:
          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_sha }}
        run: |
          git fetch origin "refs/heads/$SOURCE_BRANCH"
          if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$SOURCE_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::checkout does not match requested source"
            exit 1
          fi
          branch_sha=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$SOURCE_SHA" "$branch_sha"; then
            echo "::error::$SOURCE_SHA is not contained in $SOURCE_BRANCH"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Require protected signing credentials
        env:
          MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE }}
          MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE }}
          MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARY_KEY: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARY_KEY }}
          MACOS_NOTARY_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARY_KEY_ID }}
          MACOS_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          missing=false
          for name in \
            MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE \
            MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD \
            MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE \
            MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD \
            MACOS_NOTARY_KEY \
            MACOS_NOTARY_KEY_ID \
            MACOS_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID \
            MACOS_TEAM_ID; do
            if [ -z "${!name}" ]; then
              echo "::error::$name is unavailable in native-release-signing"
              missing=******
            fi
          done
          if [ "$missing" = ****** ]; then
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Prepare protected notary credential
        env:
          NOTARY_KEY: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARY_KEY }}
        run: |
          umask 077
          key_path="$RUNNER_TEMP/hvir-notary-key.p8"
          printf '%s' "$NOTARY_KEY" > "$key_path"
          echo "APPLE_API_KEY=$key_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build signed and notarized package
        env:
          CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE }}
          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_APPLICATION_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          CSC_INSTALLER_LINK: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE }}
          CSC_INSTALLER_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARY_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_API_ISSUER: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID }}
        run: npm run pack:mac:arm64:signed

      - name: Staple notarization ticket
        run: |
          package=$(find dist -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'hvir-*-macos-arm64.pkg' -print)
          if [ -z "$package" ] || [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$package" | wc -l)" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::Expected exactly one macOS package"
            exit 1
          fi
          xcrun stapler staple "$package"
          xcrun stapler validate "$package"

      - name: Install, update, launch, and remove signed package
        env:
          HVIR_MACOS_PACKAGE_ACCEPTANCE: '1'
          HVIR_MACOS_PACKAGE_MODE: signed
          HVIR_MACOS_EXPECTED_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_TEAM_ID }}
        run: npm run smoke:macos:installed

      - name: Remove protected notary credential
        if: always()
        run: rm -f -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/hvir-notary-key.p8"

      - name: Give the accepted artifact its public release name
        run: |
          package_version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          source="dist/hvir-${package_version}-macos-arm64.pkg"
          target="hvir-${package_version}-darwin-arm64.pkg"
          if [ ! -f "$source" ] || [ -e "dist/$target" ]; then
            echo "::error::Expected exactly one accepted package at $source"
            exit 1
          fi
          mv -- "$source" "dist/$target"
          (
            cd dist
            shasum -a 256 "$target" > "$target.sha256"
            shasum -a 256 --check "$target.sha256"
          )

      - name: Retain accepted package for release assembly
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7

 # hvir
 
 `hvir` is a desktop workbench for terminal-centric development. It combines a Ghostty-based terminal experience with file viewing, diffing, git tools, SSH workspaces, session recovery, document review, and configurable terminal profiles/themes.
 
 ## Features
 
 - Terminal workspaces with split panes, search, recovery, and attention handling
 - File tree, source/markdown rendering, large-file viewing, and diff support
 - Git views for status, history, branches, and graph-based workflows
 - Local and SSH-backed project hosts
 - Sessions and workspace persistence
 - Document review and web-pane surfaces
 - Harness profiles, terminal themes, and app settings
 
 ## Requirements
 
 - Node.js 24 or newer
 - npm
 - A supported desktop environment for Electron
 
 ## Getting started
 
 ```bash
 npm ci
 npm run dev
 ```
 
 The app opens with a project/workspace picker on first launch. You can also pass a project root when starting the app if your workflow uses one.
 
 ## Common scripts
 
 | Command | Purpose |
 | --- | --- |
 | `npm run dev` | Start the Electron app in development mode |
 | `npm run build` | Type-check and build the app |
 | `npm run preview` | Preview the built renderer |
 | `npm run test` | Run the Vitest suite |
 | `npm run lint` | Run ESLint |
 | `npm run typecheck` | Type-check main and renderer code |
 | `npm run verify` | Run policy, architecture, lint, type, and test checks |
 | `npm run smoke` | Run the Electron smoke scenarios |
 | `npm run smoke:macos` | Run the macOS-focused smoke scenarios |
 | `npm run smoke:linux:installed` | Validate the installed Linux package |
 | `npm run smoke:macos:installed` | Validate the installed macOS package |
 
 ## Packaging
 
 The repository includes native packaging workflows for:
 
 - macOS arm64 package builds
 - Linux deb package builds for x64 and arm64
 - Signed and notarized macOS release assembly
 
 Useful commands:
 
 ```bash
 npm run pack:mac:arm64
 npm run pack:linux:x64
 npm run pack:linux:arm64
 ```
 
 ## Repository layout
 
 - `src/main` — Electron main process, IPC, project/workspace coordination, PTY, SSH, and packaging support
 - `src/renderer` — React UI for the workbench, terminal, viewer, git, sessions, settings, and document review
 - `src/preload` — Preload bridge
 - `scripts` — Build, smoke, release, and maintenance scripts
 - `test` — Vitest unit/integration coverage and packaging checks
 
 ## Notes
 
 - Runtime dependencies are verified during install to ensure the checked-out `ghostty-web` artifacts match the expected terminal capability profile.
 - The project uses Electron Vite and keeps native modules external so they load from `node_modules` at runtime.
